Question Choices: Write an inequality: Temperature is warmer than 18°C. Use T to represent temperature
Hints: Decide which direction is required and whether equality is allowed.
Solution: “warmer than” means strictly greater than. Therefore T>18. The boundary itself is excluded.

Question Choices: Write an inequality: You drink at least 40 ounces of water. Use W to represent water
Hints: Decide which direction is required and whether equality is allowed.
Solution: “at least” means greater than or equal to. Therefore W≥40. The boundary is included.

Question Choices: Select. Which listed feature belongs to the number-line graph of X > 30?: ~~Filled-dot-at-30 | Open-circle-at-30 | Shaded-left~~
Hints: Check whether the boundary is included, then choose the direction.
Solution: > excludes 30, so use an open circle at 30. Shade right for greater values; a filled dot would wrongly include the boundary, and left shading has the wrong direction.
